gloss_en: Money / material wealth (mamon) — a person's monetary possessions, riches (ashirut), and livelihood (parnasah), treated in Likutey Moharan as one spiritual category ('a man's money that stands him on his feet'), figured as a wall, face, feet, the left side, etc.; not any homographic word, and distinct from the craving for money (ta'avat mamon) as a vice, which appears only as a partner concept here
